blocks.x: Funding for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program NEA Jazz Master interview was provided by the National Endowment for the Arts.
Interviewer: Dr. Anthony Brown with sound engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, pp. 107

Today is November 10th, 2011, and this is The Smithsonian Oral History Interview with NEA Jazz Master, percussionist, pianist, bandleader, composer, arranger, educator, and my hero, Jack DeJohnette, in his house in Silver Hollow, Upstate New York. How are you doing today, Mr. DeJohnette?
If we could start the interview by you stating your full name, full birth name, birthplace and birth date?
Okay. Jack DeJohnette…born in Chicago, Illinois in the county of Cook, August 9th, 1942.
